text:
sinead: Quick one  I'm in Dublin next Thursday around Temple Bar for a 1pm client lunch. Looking for something not too touristy, easy seating for 3. Any go-tos?
conor: If you want classic Irish without the chaos, The Woollen Mills near the river is nice and usually calm.
liam: For seafood, Fish Shop on Coppinger Row is solid and quick.
aoife: Brother Hubbard (north) has great mezze-style plates and veg options, might be a 15min walk.
pat: If you want something very casual and local, Bunsen for burgers is quick and reliable.
sinead: Client prefers quieter place and one is vegetarian. Also need somewhere with decent wifi.
liam: Woollen Mills has big windows and isn't too noisy, wifi ok. Brother Hubbard is great for veg.
conor: Fish Shop is small but fast service, less laptop-friendly.
aoife: Poll: react with emoji  :scales: for Fish Shop (seafood), :bread: for Woollen Mills (gastropub), :leafy_green: for Brother Hubbard (veg-friendly), :hamburger: for Bunsen (quick/casual).
lunchbot: Poll created  react to vote. (auto)
liam: :bread:
conor: :scales:

sinead: :bread: (leaning Woollen Mills if they can seat 3)
conor: Quick nav: Woollen Mills map https://maps.app.goo.gl/example-woollen
liam: If Woollen Mills can't seat 3 at 1pm, Brother Hubbard is my backup.
sinead: Anyone able to call and check availability?
aoife: I can ring Woollen Mills in 10mins and report back.
aoife: Update  Woollen Mills says walk-ins at lunchtime but they can hold a callback list for a 1pm table for 3.
sinead: Perfect. I'll take the callback slot. Thanks all!
